security_audit.summary: The command-related static findings are Markdown false positives, not executable Ruby or shell interpolation. The real risks are LINEAR_API_KEY handling, optional .env secret access, and state-changing Linear milestone operations. No prompt injection text or secret exfiltration intent was found.

remediation.suggestion: Document least-privilege Linear API key requirements and ensure commands never print or persist the token.
Only load LINEAR_API_KEY from .env and avoid reading or exposing unrelated variables.
Require explicit user confirmation before creating or updating milestones in shared Linear workspaces.

content.user_title: Manage Linear Milestones from the CLI
content.value_statement: Teams need a fast way to keep Linear milestones aligned with delivery plans. This skill documents CLI commands for creating and updating milestones.
actual_capabilities: Creates Linear project milestones with a name and project identifier.
Updates milestone names, descriptions, and target dates.
Accepts project names or UUIDs for create commands.
Supports machine-readable command output when requested.
Documents Linear API key setup and Bun runtime prerequisites.
limitations: Requires a valid Linear API key with sufficient permissions.
Requires Bun and the referenced CLI files to be installed.
Does not include read-only discovery commands in this package.
Can modify live Linear workspace data.

use_cases.title: Create Release Milestones
use_cases.description: Add planned release milestones to a Linear project with names, descriptions, and target dates.

use_cases.title: Update Delivery Dates
use_cases.description: Adjust milestone target dates when project schedules change.

use_cases.title: Standardize Launch Tracking
use_cases.description: Keep milestone names and descriptions consistent across release projects.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Milestone
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner setup for a single milestone.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a Linear milestone named Alpha Release in the Mount Vernon project. Ask for confirmation before running the command.

prompt_templates.title: Create with Target Date
prompt_templates.scenario: Add scheduling details during milestone creation.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a Linear milestone named Beta in the Monticello project with target date 2026-09-15. Confirm the project before writing.

prompt_templates.title: Update Milestone Details
prompt_templates.scenario: Change fields on an existing milestone.
prompt_templates.prompt: Update milestone abc123 to use the name Beta Release and target date 2026-10-01. Show the planned change first.

prompt_templates.title: Coordinate Release Cleanup
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced workflow for multiple milestone changes.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review these requested milestone changes, identify any missing IDs or dates, then update each Linear milestone after explicit approval.

output_examples.input: Create Alpha Release for the Mount Vernon project.
output_examples.output: The milestone is created in the selected Linear project with the requested name.

output_examples.input: Move milestone abc123 to a March 15 target date.
output_examples.output: The milestone target date is updated after the user confirms the change.

output_examples.input: Rename a milestone and add a release description.
output_examples.output: The milestone reflects the new name and description in Linear.

best_practices: Confirm project names and milestone IDs before running write commands.
Use least-privilege Linear API keys for automation tasks.
Record milestone changes in team release notes or planning docs.
anti_patterns: Do not run update commands without confirming the target milestone.
Do not store Linear API keys in committed files.
Do not use partial project names when multiple matches are likely.

faq.question: What does this skill do?
faq.answer: It documents CLI commands for creating and updating Linear project milestones.

faq.question: Does it require a Linear API key?
faq.answer: Yes. The skill requires LINEAR_API_KEY in the environment or a local environment file.

faq.question: Can it update existing milestones?
faq.answer: Yes. It can update milestone names, descriptions, and target dates by milestone ID.

faq.question: Can it list milestones?
faq.answer: No. The documented commands focus on create and update operations only.

faq.question: Which runtime is required?
faq.answer: The documented commands require the Bun runtime.

faq.question: Is this safe for shared workspaces?
faq.answer: Use confirmation before each write because commands can modify live Linear workspace data.
